category: Open-Source Infrastructure Monitoring, Server Metrics & Real-Time Performance Observability

repos.name: Netdata
repos.description: Real-time, low-latency infrastructure metrics collector and automated health monitoring agent with per-second granularity
highlights: Per-second metric resolution with zero-configuration auto-detection of 800+ hardware and software targets
Ultra-low CPU overhead (<1% single core) and efficient circular buffer in-memory architecture
Out-of-the-box ML-based anomaly detection running locally on the monitored node

repos.name: Prometheus
repos.description: Cloud-native computing foundation monitoring system and time-series database with expressive PromQL query engine
highlights: Industry standard pull-model metrics scraper with service discovery across Kubernetes and cloud providers
Expressive PromQL query language for dimensional slice-and-dice aggregations and alerting rules
Autonomous single-node reliability with local TSDB storage and zero external clustering dependencies

repos.name: Glances
repos.description: Cross-platform system monitoring tool with CLI curses UI, RESTful JSON API, and Web interface
highlights: Unified cross-platform monitoring across Linux, macOS, Windows, and BSD operating systems
Embedded bottle-based web UI and REST API exporting metrics to InfluxDB, Prometheus, or Grafana
Client/server mode allowing centralized remote monitoring of hundreds of server nodes
